prompt: I have a CSV with 50,000 rows of customer transactions — columns are date, amount, category (12 categories), and region (4 regions). My VP wants a dashboard for the quarterly review. What should I build?

assertions.text: Recommends a line chart for temporal trends
Recommends bar charts for category comparison
Considers the executive audience and keeps recommendations simple
Mentions sample size implications (50K rows may need WebGL or aggregation for scatter)
Suggests a limited number of charts (4-6) for a dashboard
Provides plotly code snippets or patterns for at least one recommended chart
